brief.about: The Arts of Becoming is a living body of work by Kathleen Marie Rose: practices, experiences and creative works for remembering your nature, liberating what is alive, and bringing more of your truth into form. It includes embodiment and practice, courses and circles, earth and living systems, creative work, a writing journal, and The Thread, a personalized 1:1 mentorship. True To Essence (soulcentric photography) is part of this world but lives on its own site at truetoessence.com.
brief.audience: People at a threshold who want to remember who they are and live more truthfully. They should be able to quickly see what this is and where to enter: explore the arts, begin a conversation about The Thread, read the journal, or reach out.
